name: gr-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Greece for 2026. Covers the private company (ΙΚΕ, Law 4072/2012), the limited liability company (ΕΠΕ, Law 3190/1955) and the société anonyme (ΑΕ, Law 4548/2018); capital (an ΙΚΕ's capital is set freely and may be zero; EUR 1 minimum for an ΕΠΕ, EUR 25,000 for an ΑΕ), full payment of ΙΚΕ capital and the one-month certificate; formation through the One-Stop Shop (ΥΜΣ) or the online e-ΥΜΣ and GEMI registration under Law 4919/2022; the 2025 fee schedule (EUR 60, or EUR 18 online, plus the EUR 10 GEMI fee and a 0.1% Competition Commission fee for an ΑΕ); founder conditions (an active Greek tax number); the same-day or next-day check; GEMI fines; and the first tax and payroll steps. Trigger phrases: set up a company in Greece, ΙΚΕ, ΑΕ, ΕΠΕ, ΓΕΜΗ, Υπηρεσία Μιας Στάσης, e-ΥΜΣ, minimum capital Greece.
